record.original_question: Are finite type pseudoconvex domains in C^2 locally convexifiable with biholomorphic maps with continuous boundary values?

evidence.quote: Problem 7.4.2 Are finite type pseudoconvex domains in C2 locally convexifiable with biholomorphic maps with continuous boundary values? 7.5 The Kobayashi Metric k

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^2$ be a smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domain of finite type (in the sense of D'Angelo / Kohn), and let $p \in \partial \Omega$. Does there exist an open neighborhood $U$ of $p$ in $\mathbb{C}^2$ and a biholomorphic map $\Phi : U \cap \Omega \to \Phi(U \cap \Omega) \subset \mathbb{C}^2$ such that:

(i) $\Phi(U \cap \Omega)$ is a convex domain in $\mathbb{C}^2$, and

(ii) $\Phi$ extends continuously to $U \cap \overline{\Omega}$?

In other words, is every finite type pseudoconvex domain in $\mathbb{C}^2$ locally convexifiable near each boundary point by a biholomorphism with continuous boundary values?
artifact.status_search_result: A direct resolution of the question of local convexifiability of finite type pseudoconvex domains in $\mathbb{C}^2$ by biholomorphisms with continuous boundary values does not appear in the available search results. Related work (e.g., Diederich–Fornæss–Wold on exposing points and convexifiable domains of finite 1-type, and works on McNeal/Catlin's normal forms in $\mathbb{C}^2$) addresses neighboring questions but does not conclusively settle this exact formulation. Status appears unverified in the public literature found.

status_evidence.title: Exposing Points on the Boundary of a Strictly Pseudoconvex or a Locally Convexifiable Domain of Finite 1-Type
status_evidence.snippet: For bounded domains of 1-type 2k locally convexifiable at a boundary point with a Stein neighborhood basis, a biholomorphic map exposing the point exists.
status_evidence.claim: Related results on locally convexifiable finite-type domains exist but do not directly establish the local convexifiability question with continuous boundary values.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic characterizations of strong pseudoconvexity on pseudoconvex domains of finite type in C^2
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of strong pseudoconvexity via boundary behavior of intrinsic invariants on finite-type domains in C^2.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on finite-type domains in C^2 does not assert local convexifiability with continuous boundary values.
